description: Fabrikam seeks to reduce recurring Azure spend for analytics pipelines while maintaining nightly SLAs. Review current PaaS choices, scaling rules, storage tiers, and ingress patterns for cost-risk tradeoffs and right-sizing recommendations.
constraints: Nightly batch must complete by 06:00 UTC
No reduction of RPO beyond 24 hours without executive sign-off
requiredCapabilities: Azure Synapse or Fabric-capable SQL pools (representative)
Azure Functions or Container Apps for orchestration
assumptions: Read-only architecture export available for optional cost fidelity
Traffic patterns stable quarter over quarter
topologyHints: Prefer serverless or scale-to-zero for intermittent workloads
